en.html:
Refreshed? Not in the least.

Peace of mind was as far away as ever.

If anything, my limbs were heavier. The weight of my sins, which that dream had made me face again.

But I did not resent the weight. Mine to carry, I understood that.

It told me what Kageaki Minato had piled up in forcing his will through.

Will.

An aim I had resolved to reach, even at the cost of taking others' lives.

Not yet achieved.

It had to be achieved.

Step onto a road where lives are crushed beneath your soles, and you must go to the end. Absolutely to the end.

A road that tramples others' lives has no turning back.

Not unless you can bring back those you killed.

気分は、全く爽快ではない。
　晴れやかさとはどこまでも縁遠い。

　むしろ手足は重さを増している。
　それは今の夢が改めて直面させた、俺の罪の重さだ。

　その重さを、しかし――厭わない。
　これは俺の背負うべきものなのだと自覚する。

　この重さが、俺に教える。
　これは湊斗景明が意思を貫徹する為に、重ねてきた
罪なのだと。

　意思。

　他人の命を略奪してでも、果たさねばならぬのだと、
決意した目的があった。
　それはまだ、遂げていない。

　遂げねばならぬ。
　一度、人の命を靴底に潰して行く道程へ踏み出した
以上は、断じて最後までゆかねばならぬ。

　他人の生命を踏みしめてゆく道は、決して引き返せ
ない道。
　殺した者を生き返らせてやれないのなら、決して。

Our roads had parted already.

I understood it.

A road I could not turn back from was mine. Ichijou had such a road too.

What <ruby>Muramasa<rt>I</rt></ruby> would be from now on, Ichijou could never accept.

Just as I could no longer accept <ruby>Masamune<rt>Ichijou</rt></ruby>.

For a time my delusion had <ruby>twisted<rt>twisted</rt></ruby> the two roads together. That was gone now.

The roads were separate.

Ichijou and I would go different ways.

Kageaki"Kill the enemy you hate, and kill the friend beside you as well... If you recoil from that, do not kill the enemy in the first place. The resolve required of you is not there."
Kageaki"Put down Muramasa, take up a weapon other than Muramasaanother, and kill? Out of the question. Kill the enemy but lose no ally—that is cowardice・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・. If you will not let an ally die, then you should not kill the enemy either."
Kageaki"An enemy's death, an ally's death: equal value. One must not put a difference between them. One cannot... That difference is only the narrowing of one's own selfish view."
Kageaki"The enemy is evil, and good as well. See only the evil, only the guilt, and kill—what is that but vile deception? Committing a killing while hiding its ugliness."
Kageaki"With this one blade, cut good and evil together. That resolve is required. From anyone who kills anyone————"
